checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One silent 9:16 video of about 15 s with three moving product shots
must.why: I only got two 3 s clips (orbit and close glide). The final video, the wide pull-back shot and the cards were not provided. Both clips report sound with peak 0 dB, though the final may have had it stripped.

must.item: Sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, white sole, no logo
must.why: In the orbit and close-up frames the shoe is plain white with white laces and sole and no logo. The close-up lace and tab details differ a little from the base picture. The wide shot was not seen.

must.item: Captions read exactly the three lines in order
must.why: No caption card frames were provided.

must.item: Every caption stays within the central 70% width and 60% height
must.why: No caption frames were provided, so the margins could not be measured.

must.item: Captions are legible and visible long enough
must.why: No caption frames were provided. The agent's stated 2 s per card with white on #111111 is plausible but unverified.

exact_text.read_as: not visible in any provided frame
not visible in any provided frame
not visible in any provided frame

faults.what: No caption card frames or final assembled video were provided, so the key requirement (captions, order, margins) cannot be verified.
The close-up glide shows slight lace and tab changes between frames, and the eyelet and lace structure is not fully consistent with the orbit shot. This is a minor morphing risk.
Both clips report an audio track with peak 0 dB, so the final video may not be silent unless the audio was stripped in assembly.

summary: The two shots provided, a clean white-sneaker orbit and a close lace glide, look good and show no logo, but the caption cards, the wide shot and the final 15 s video could not be seen, so the captions and margins are unverified.
